```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(p8105.datasets)
```

## Setting Options

```{r, eval = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```


#Load in Data set 
```{r}
data("nyc_airbnb")
nyc_airbnb
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb = 
  nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(stars = review_scores_location/ 2)
```

#Some Questions
What are some of the most expensive air bnbs in nyc? 

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  count(neighbourhood_group) 
```


```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  count(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type, 
    values_from = n 
  )
```

Which neighborhood has the highest concentration? 
Which one is the cheapest? 

#Price

Cheapest 
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(price)) |> 
  filter(price_rank <3) |>  view()
```

# Most Expensive
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(neighbourhood_group) |> 
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(price)) |> 
  filter(price_rank <10) |>  view() |> 
  filter(price_rank < 2)
```
#Plots

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(price < 1000) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=price)) +
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_grid(room_type ~ neighbourhood_group)
```

Prices on average

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  group_by(room_type, neighbourhood_group) |> 
  summarize(
    median_price = median(price)
  ) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type, 
    values_from = median_price
  )
```

Neighborhoods in Manhattan

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>  
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter( price < 500) |> 
  filter(room_type != "Shared Room") |> 
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |> 
  ggplot (aes(x= neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot () +
  facet_grid(. ~room_type)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text (angle = 90, hjust = 1))

```
Knowing how ggplot does this is helpful, neighborhoods in alphabetical order

#Visualize price some more

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |> 
  filter (price< 500) |> 
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |> 
  ggplot (aes(x= lat, y= long, color= price))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5)
```


Which airbnb hosts are the most/ best reviewed? 

#Some Host Stuff

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |> 
filter(calculated_host_listings_count > 10) |>  view()
```


Has the number increased or decreased over time? 
Do Airbnbs affect rent in their neighborhoods/ buildings? 
Do descriptioins parlay with price?
